Understanding Tax Sales in Essex County

Essex County conducts tax sales as needed, without a fixed annual schedule. These auctions are typically held online, allowing you to bid from the comfort of your home. To find out about upcoming sales, regularly check the county’s official website or the auction company’s page.​

Auction Timing and Registration

  • When: Auctions usually conclude at 11:00 AM Eastern Standard Time (EST). Always verify the exact time in the official auction notice.​
  • Registration: You must register to participate. Registration periods vary for each auction, so review the specific auction announcement for details.​

Bidding Process and Payment Terms

  1. Bidding: Properties are sold to the highest bidder. A 10% buyer’s premium is added to the winning bid.​
  2. Deposit: The winning bidder must deposit 10% of the total sale price by the close of business on the specified date, typically within a week after the auction ends.​
  3. Final Payment: The remaining balance is due within 15 days after court approval. Acceptable payment methods include wire transfers, cash, or certified checks.​

Property Redemption Rights

Property owners can redeem their property at any time before the sale by paying all due taxes, penalties, interest, and associated costs. This means a property listed for auction may be removed if the owner settles their debts before the auction date.​

Staying Updated on Upcoming Auctions

To stay informed about upcoming tax sales:​

  • Visit the Essex County Treasurer’s Office website regularly.​
  • Check the For Sale At Auction website for announcements and details.​
